This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue was about reports appearing duplicated on adjacent pages due to lack of stable ordering in the pagination query. This was fixed in version 3.2.1 by ordering reports by id as well when they have the same creation timestamp. The reporter confirmed the fix after upgrading to 3.2.1. The fix is already deployed, so no code change PR is needed now.
